This model-turned-housewife spends her days doing quality control for her vineyard. She is also an excellent homemaker who loves cooking gourmet meals, fine art, and throwing parties. A little bit of light detective work reveals that Bree should be in her late 40s, though she's never directly confirmed this. To this day, her age remains a mystery.

While Bree enjoys the finer things in life and the wealth she and her husband share, she quickly becomes stressed at large, ritzy gatherings and has lost her taste for the rush of the city - especially where she feels reduced to only being seen as Walter's attractive wife. In coming to the island and starting the vineyard, she's discovered a love of gardening despite her dislike of getting her hands dirty.

Bree lives with her husband Walter, son Luke, and the family's pet dog Taco at Hillside Manor near the brewery and vineyard they own. Though she and her husband have been known to get into the odd spat withing listening distance, their arguments have not been seen to have had a lasting strain on their marriage. She's also very proud of her son and his handling of the vineyard's business operations, though she worries about his occasional bouts of indecisiveness and acknowledges that the trait was likely inherited from her.

Bree is good friends with her neighbor [[dinda|Dinda]] and meets up with her at the [[carpenter|Carpenter]] to gossip most Thursdays. Through these visits, she's become fairly familiar with Dinda's son [[archie|Archie]] who also drops by the vineyard frequently to play with Taco.

On rare occasions that he is free, he enjoys long walks, discussing theories of unexplainable phenomena with [[alice|Alice]], and watching a gourmet gelato-making show, Game of Cones. betty.x: Betty is one of the characters in Coral Island that the player can [[friendship|befriend]]. She used to run [[fishensips|Fishensips]] together with her late husband and is now retired.

Betty is a dutiful wife, mother, and pillar of the Coral Island community. Back in the day, Betty used to run the tavern with her late husband, Frank Sr. Now, she spends her retirement days going around town re-filling bird feeders, educating kids about coral reefs, and baking patisseries.
She worries greatly for the future of the island where her family has lived for generations and of her four children, especially following the loss of her husband.
Betty has a stronger will than her family sometimes gives her credit for, boldly challenging [[pufferfish-drilling-corp|Pufferfish Drilling Corp]] and its representatives where she can.

Betty lives in the upstairs of the Fishensips tavern with her son [[noah|Noah]] and daughter [[aaliyah|Aaliyah]]. Another son, [[frank|Frank]], lives nearby with his wife [[erika|Erika]] and cats [[peanut|Peanut]] and [[butter-character|Butter]]. Her third son [[eddy|Eddy]] lives abroad and keeps in touch via letters, though he is prone to forgetting to respond causing a great deal of worry to his family, his mother in particular. Her age and the loss of her husband has left her with a lot of anxiety over keeping her family close and safe, which causes some strain with those of her children who would rather pursue their own dreams.

Betty is a frequent help to [[connor|Connor]] in setting up the town's festivals and maintaining the town's gardens. She also teaches the [[starlet-elementary-school|Starlet Elementary School]] class for [[randy|Randy]] on Thursdays, a position she volunteered for after Erika did the same.

Betty is friendly with some of the island's other cooks, bakers, and restaurant owners like [[eva|Eva]], [[emma|Emma]], and [[raj|Raj]], and she's known [[alice|Alice]] and [[suki|Suki]] since they were young.

Scott is currently working at the town's [[museum|Museum]] and renting a room from [[charles|Charles]] at [[charles-house|Charles House]] in [[starlet-town|Starlet Town]]. Scott is a city boy at heart. Always up for fun and is never a bore. He found his passion for [[artifact|artifacts]] and has dedicated his life to it. After many heartbreaks and not wanting to be known as the town’s infamous playboy, Scott moved to Coral Island to start a new life. Aside from getting into relationships, Scott enjoys strong coffee, rainy days, and vintage jazz. He frequents the [[fishensips|Local Tavern]] on the weekend.

Scott mentions he had his first heartbreak on second grade in spring. He also mentions playing with his school friend Aiden. Scott lives with his roommate, [[charles|Charles]], at his house. He is also friends with his coworker [[millie|Millie]]. He also mentions having a hard time dating, sharing his three failed serious relationships.

archie.x: Archie is one of the child characters in Coral Island that the player can [[friendship|befriend]]. He lives with his parents [[joko|Joko]] and [[dinda|Dinda]], and attends the only [[starlet-elementary-school|school]] on the island.

Archie loves animals and can often be found at the [[hillside-brewery-and-vineyard|Vineyard]] playing with [[taco|Taco]] the dog. He wants to be a vet one day - something that the locals desperately need. Currently, they only have [[kenny|Kenny]] giving out internet advice; while free, it is inaccurate at times. Archie enjoys Mexican food, loves bugs and stray animals around town.
Archie also has an extensive rock collection - to his mom's frustration - and enjoys singing and hiking in the woods with his dad.

Archie lives with his parents Joko and Dinda, and his adult cousin "Uncle" [[surya|Surya]]. Archie and his dad are particularly close, with Archie frequently waiting for his dad to finish his work so the two can go hiking and fishing in the woods after school. He has some minor disagreements with his mom, on the other hand, who makes him limit his ever-growing rock collection and tries to keep him from wandering too far from home. He still adores her though and considers her fish tacos to be the best.

Archie attends [[randy|Randy]]'s class at [[starlet-elementary-school|Starlet Elementary School]]. He is good friends with the other kids in his class and can be found sharing comics and detective stories with Oliver and playing games with Valentina.

Archie looks up to [[kenny|Kenny]] for his knowledge on animals, [[theo|Theo]] for his singing abilities, and his cousin [[surya|Surya]] for his scientific knowledge. He is on friendly terms with [[bree|Bree]] through her friendship with his mother and he frequently visits her home to play with Taco.

Yuri is not your usual MD—she spent her 20s as a doctor who crossed many borders, frequently dispatched to remote areas to practice for little to no pay. Presumably why she has no decent savings and decided to settle in [[starlet-town|Starlet Town]], a boat ride away from her hometown, Tosaka. She is close with her roommate, [[millie|Millie]], and fellow MD, [[charles|Charles]].

anne.x: Anne is one of the characters in Coral Island that the player can [[friendship|befriend]]. She lives in the town together with her husband [[paul|Paul]], her daughter [[zoe|Zoe]], and younger brother [[mark|Mark]]. Anne makes a living by filming wildlife documentaries around Coral Island.

On weekends, Anne can be found at the beach, enjoying the weather and sharpening her volleyball skills. She likes carrots and hummus combo for snacks and a cup of green tea to start the day. Anne is deeply concerned by the health and well-being of the natural world and especially of the wildlife living on Coral Island. She had hoped to have more of a chance to travel the world, but having her daughter has led her to put those plans aside for now and made her more safety-conscious.
Working as a wildlife photographer and videographer and having an energetic daughter have taught Anne a lot about having patience, something she's quick to encourage others to learn.

Anne lives with her husband Paul, who hosts the nature documentary series the two record, their school-age daughter Zoe, and Anne's adventurer brother Mark. Anne and Paul make a good team in working on their show, though Anne can sometimes be frustrated with Paul's habit of foraging for wild produce instead of simply picking things up from the [[sams-general-store|Sam's General Store]].

She also struggles to manage her daughter's adventurous streak, struggling to keep her safe and encouraging her to at least finish school before going too far. She worries about being considered a nag for her efforts.
While the developer's have confirmed Mark to be Anne's younger brother and he does live with her family, much of their relationship has yet to be seen in-game.
Anne and her family are [[bonbon|Bonbon]]'s owner.

ben.x: Ben is one of the characters in Coral Island that the player can [[friendship|befriend]] and eventually [[romance|romance]]. He is a nomad who lives in a [[caravan|caravan]] stationed in the forest and might have some random things to sell on weekends. Ben spends his money attending the [[fall|Fall]] music festivals and [[green-tea|green tea]].
Despite not being initially a , he was added as a bachelor due to Coral Island's Kickstarter crowdfunding campaign reaching its US$750,000 stretch goal.

Ben is an easy-going guy who takes life at his own pace. Coming across as spacey at times, he has firm beliefs in the power of positive thinking, importance of vibes, and meanings that can be taken from dreams. Ben claims to understand to feelings of many of the wares he sells from his caravan and his prices can vary from day to day based on them. Ben is also vegan and against cages in all forms.
During the last two weeks of Fall, he goes on a road trip, leaving his usual parking spot in the forest and returning at the beginning of Winter with new goods to sell at the Winter Fair.

Ben lives alone in his caravan in the forest and does not mention his family. Despite this, he is friendly with several of the Coral Island townies and specifically mentions [[luke|Luke]] and his parents as being like family to him. He also seems to be close to [[suki|Suki]] as she's one of the first people he goes to when he returns from his yearly trip. He does odd jobs for [[sam|Sam]] and [[jack|Jack]] as well to help supplement the income from his store.
Funbucket is Ben's pet duck that lives at Jack's Ranch. He and Funbucket are close enough that Ben seems to be able to understand Funbucket's quacks with excellent accuracy.

charles.x: Charles is one of the characters in Coral Island that the player can [[friendship|befriend]] and eventually [[romance|romance]]. He is one of the town doctors, the other being [[yuri|Yuri]].
Though not initially a , he was added as a bachelor due to Coral Island's Kickstarter crowdfunding campaign reaching its US$750,000 stretch goal.

As can be expected of a doctor, Charles is very health conscious - both physically and mentally - and frequently offers health tips and reminders to the people he runs into around town. He has a less overt interest in fashion as well, and makes an effort to keep his hair stylish and healthy.

Charles lives at [[charles-house|Charles House]] with his housemate Scott. The two seem to get along well enough despite their different personalities. He is also friendly with his co-worker at the clinic Yuri, and the [[community-center|Community Center]] librarian [[millie|Millie]] whom he sees often when picking up new books.
Charles is a frequent visitor to the [[hair-salon|Hair Salon]] and has a decent rapport with [[erika|Erika]] as his usual stylist.

According to his Kickstarter biography, Charles has been disowned by his parents for something in his youth and more recently separated from his ex-fiancee after catching them cheating. He's struggled with pursuing romantic relationships since, but has come to better appreciate the welcoming and open-mindedness he's been met with since coming to Coral Island.

connor.x: Connor is one of the characters in Coral Island that the player can [[friendship|befriend]]. Connor is the mayor of the town who loves Coral Island and knows all the islanders.

Connor is the friendly and usually cheerful mayor of Starlet Town. He can often be found making rounds to the various businesses in town to collect taxes, enforce codes, and mostly to visit with the owners - and if he can support the businesses a little by buying something as well, he gladly does that too. Before his election as mayor, he ran a general store in the storefront [[socket-and-pan|Socket and Pan]] now occupies with his late wife. As much as he loves the island and town and working for their betterment, he sometimes regrets not taking more time to travel with his wife.
Connor owns a hat for every season which he typically decorates with a seasonal flower.

Connor lives alone in his house north of the town following the death of his late wife Carol. To help combat the loneliness left by her loss, he frequently visits the many business owners and attends town meetings and festivals to spend time with the townies, most of whom he's on good terms with.
Connor has a particular closeness with [[nina|Nina]] who he's known since her infancy and [[luke|Luke]] who runs Socket and Pan out of the storefront Connor once ran his own shop out of.

wakuu.x: Wakuu is a character in Coral Island and one of the available marriage candidates. He is an astronomer who works and resides in the local [[observatory|Observatory]].

Wakuu is a polite and sensitive individual, yet not very sociable. He feels that the days he spent living on a boat made him lack social skills and thus does not have many friends. Due to this as well, he is not often seen in cutscenes with a lot of people, such as when the demonstration took place in front of [[pufferfish|Pufferfish]] office. Despite preferring solitude, he gets along mostly well with Chaem who lives together with him in the Observatory.

Wakuu is the son of [[wataru|Wataru]]. They lived together on a boat since Wataru works as a fisherman before moving into the [[lighthouse|Lighthouse]].
